activation_baseline.basis: Vesper Arlen v679-v3 immutable repository seal plus the separately attributable three-failure and three-recovery pre-send overlay supplied by the acknowledged activation

startup_observations.description: A read-only worktree listing was invoked outside a Git repository.
startup_observations.recovery: Resolve the exact Vesper source worktree before any further Git probe.

startup_observations.description: A PowerShell-expanded wildcard was passed where the text searcher required literal file paths.
startup_observations.recovery: Enumerate exact files or search a literal directory without a shell wildcard.

startup_observations.description: A broad activation text search exceeded the bounded display budget.
startup_observations.recovery: Use exact patterns and bounded numbered windows.

startup_observations.description: The initial large activation-packet window truncated before EOF.
startup_observations.recovery: Reread consecutive forty-line windows through the measured final line.

startup_observations.description: The first complete skill-creator display exceeded model context.
startup_observations.recovery: Reread the instruction file in two bounded numbered windows through EOF.

startup_observations.description: A broad receipt-oriented packet search expanded repetitive card prose and truncated.
startup_observations.recovery: Use the packet's terminal anchors and exact source-task final pointer.

startup_observations.description: A source-task read with tool outputs expanded historical content beyond the display bound.
startup_observations.recovery: Use a newest-turn read without tool outputs.

startup_observations.description: The bounded newest-turn source-task reread still exceeded the display bound.
startup_observations.recovery: Retain the truncation and extract only the exact terminal receipt pointer exposed in the final segment.

startup_observations.description: A bounded search across conventional receipt banks found no matching Vesper receipt.
startup_observations.recovery: Follow the exact terminal source pointer to the D-isolated phase-scratch receipt.

startup_observations.description: The first receipt projection guessed field names that were absent and returned nulls.
startup_observations.recovery: Inspect root keys, then project the observed exact fields.

startup_observations.description: A per-entry Git-show manifest verifier exceeded its time bound and outlived the wrapper.
startup_observations.recovery: Stop the exact read-only process, verify clean state, and replace repeated subprocesses.

startup_observations.description: A full-tree map recovery was too broad and exceeded its time bound.
startup_observations.recovery: Stop the exact read-only process and address only declared manifest paths.

startup_observations.description: An eager cat-file batch writer deadlocked against its unread output pipe.
startup_observations.recovery: Interleave one expression write with one framed blob read.

startup_observations.description: The first branch-existence probe used an invalid parenthesized PowerShell native-command expression.
startup_observations.recovery: Run the native command first, capture LASTEXITCODE, then construct the scalar result.

startup_observations.description: Worktree registration exceeded the direct display bound while its single Git process continued.
startup_observations.recovery: Do not repeat; inspect the exact process and wait until the branch and target path appear.

startup_observations.description: Sparse checkout exceeded the direct display bound while its exact index lock remained active.
startup_observations.recovery: Do not repeat or kill; inspect the exact lock and process until checkout completes.

startup_observations.description: A recursive diagnostic lock-file listing produced no attributable bounded result.
startup_observations.recovery: Inspect only the exact new worktree Git directory and index lock.

startup_observations.description: One exact-bound Wait-Process wrapper returned before its final scalar projection.
startup_observations.recovery: Use a separate immediate scalar state probe without repeating the underlying mutation.

startup_observations.description: A coordinated four-file title-refinement patch failed verification before writing any hunk.
startup_observations.recovery: Apply one verified file patch at a time and retain the rejected zero-write attempt.

startup_observations.description: A predecessor toolchain projection guessed a nonexistent tools array and returned null fields.
startup_observations.recovery: Inspect the observed root keys and project verification_targets, python_distributions, and command_versions.

startup_observations.description: The first title-corpus digest probe had mismatched Python collection parentheses.
startup_observations.recovery: Use an explicit two-row collection and rerun only the digest projection.

failure_retention_rule: Every timeout parser fault false assumption blocker workaround and failed witness remains visible at zero success credit.
promotion_rule: A recovery is a separate bounded passing witness and never erases the paired failure.
